move.subject: Seal 24 mm – reciprocal proposal on lead time, commitment and allocation
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to propose a reciprocal package for the 24 mm mechanical seal.

On delivery, we can accept 54 days instead of the 42-day standard lead time recorded in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410#5.1). On commitment, your capacity letter of 18 September 2026 (doc:20260918-70410-P10) says you will prioritise firm, long-term commitments. We offer exactly that: 23,400 pcs per year, binding in each year, over 24 months.

In return, we ask for full allocation of that volume at EUR 29.89/unit. All other terms stay as fixed: DAP, payment 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is a buyer benchmark, not your disclosed cost.

Does this trade work for you?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we note your willingness to commit to 23,400 units over 24 months and accept the 54-day lead time. In recognition of the extended commitment, we can revise our offer to EUR 31.70 per unit.

Consequently, our offer stands at a price of €31.70 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months, and Lieferzeit 54 days. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Mechanical seal 24 mm – revised package with a third committed year
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for confirming full allocation of 23,400 pcs per year at 54 days.

We would like to meet you with a further step. We move our price from EUR 29.89 to EUR 31.07/unit. We also add a third committed year: 23,400 pcs per year, binding in each year, over 36 months. This is in addition to accepting 54 days instead of the 42-day standard lead time in our framework agreement.

This is a substantial reciprocal commitment: a longer, firm volume base and more scheduling room for your plant. In return, we ask that this be recognised in the complete price at EUR 31.07/unit.

All other terms remain as fixed: DAP, payment 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling.

Can you confirm this package?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your proposal to extend the contract term to 36 months. In response to this commitment, we revise our price to EUR 31.30 per unit. 

Please provide the underlying volume planning data to substantiate this extended commitment. Which volume can you commit to? 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current offer stands at a price of €31.30 per unit, a Lieferzeit of 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
